scripts.build: npm run build:java && npm run build:web
scripts.build:java: npm run install:rbed && mvn -q -f scenarios/pom.xml package -DskipTests -Drbed.version=$(node version.mjs)
scripts.test: npm run install:rbed && mvn -q -f scenarios/pom.xml verify -Drbed.version=$(node version.mjs) && node --test test/*.test.mjs
